Requires nauthilus:operations_read. Filters are accepted only in the JSON body; query parameters are refused. HTTP 200 means the call was processed; `source` states the completeness of the log source. Every message group is an observation counted in the log window, not an incident; use the diagnostics operation for component state. Messages are complete; different messages are never merged, and only authentication secrets are replaced by `<redacted>`. Groups are paginated with `page.next_cursor`. Nothing is changed.
